label: Figma
terms_note: Automation allowed under Figma Developer Terms; remote MCP on all plans but Starter / View / Collab seats = 6 tool calls per MONTH, Dev/Full seats 200/day 10-20/min (create_new_file, whoami, add_code_connect_map exempt; use_figma is NOT); write-to-canvas is open beta, free now, 'eventually usage-based paid'; only clients in the Figma MCP Catalog may connect; REST Tier 1 (files/images) 10-20 req/min; variables REST = Enterprise full members only.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (REST API v1 + official remote MCP server with write tools + Plugin API).

endpoints.call: whole document JSON (import a tenant design as reference)
atomic bulk create/update/delete of collections, modes (≤ 40), variables (≤ 5000/collection), mode values (**Enterprise**, Tier 3)
leave review comments on a design
blank Design / FigJam / Slides file (rate-limit exempt)
general create / edit / inspect — pages, frames, components, variants, variables, styles, text, images
endpoints.purpose: free-form ops (counts against the tool-call cap)

endpoints.call: images into / exports out of a file
live running UI → editable layers (Claude Code first; other clients beta)

reference.limits: - REST (leaky bucket, per plan + seat): Tier 1 files/images **10/min** Starter, 15/min Professional, 20/min Organization (Dev/Full seats); Tier 2 25/50/100 per min; Tier 3 50/100/150 per min. View / Collab seats: 20 per MONTH Tier 1, 5/min Tier 2-3. 429 carries `Retry-After`, `X-Figma-Plan-Tier`, `X-Figma-Rate-Limit-Type`. - MCP tool calls: Starter View/Collab **20/month**, Starter Dev/Full 200/day 10/min; Professional View/Collab **6/month**, Dev/Full 200/day 15/min; Organization Dev/Full 600/day 20/min; Enterprise highest. Exempt: `add_code_connect_map`, `create_new_file`, `whoami`. **`use_

reason: Figma's builder offering is its own remote MCP server (https://mcp.figma.com/mcp, OAuth; tools use_figma, create_new_file, get_design_context, generate_figma_design … per https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/tools-and-prompts/), which writes to the canvas; the REST API (https://developers.figma.com/docs/rest-api/) is read-mostly (files, images, comments, Enterprise-only variables) and cannot create or edit design nodes. Pointer entry, no generated server.
